text.title: Django Services Layer Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the code artefact this methodology produces. Validator in scripts/validate-django-services.py enforces required keys, enum bounds, and pattern constraints; the forbidden-pattern list below is checked by review and by the import-linter contract, not by the schema.

section.title: Schema

example.note: All required keys present; enums, bounds and the dotted module_path pattern satisfied.

Forbidden traits: service_name not entity_action; module_path not a services module; aggregate under 2 chars; public_functions empty; write_count>1 with atomic=false; kw_only=false; http_imports or orm_outside_services above zero; missing tests_path.

forbidden.pattern: Service module imports from django.http, rest_framework.response or a template engine
View, admin or task calls Model.objects.create/save/delete directly instead of going through a service
Service function accepting an HttpRequest, view or queryset as a parameter
Service module mixing two aggregates (orders and payments in one file)
Service module organised by caller type (services/views.py, services/admin.py)
Side effect dispatched inside @transaction.atomic without on_commit

allowed-transformations.transformation: Auto-format with ruff before final review.
Sort public_functions alphabetically for diff hygiene.
